scope: Bounded atomic repair/revision evidence at the current repository scale boundary; this record is not GCC production qualification.

indexScale.test: decompengine.repair.ModuleRevisionGraphTest.sparse index selects bounded context for more than five thousand functions
indexScale.limitation: This exercises dependency-limited context selection only; it is not a real GCC driver inventory or repair run.

atomicRevision.publicationRecoveryTest: decompengine.repair.ModuleRevisionGraphTest.durable graph publication crash points recover an exact pending attempt
atomicRevision.publicationRecoveryResult: pending attempt is durably recovered as rejected and the exact accepted source bytes remain installed
atomicRevision.rollbackRecoveryTest: decompengine.repair.RepairRunSemanticsTest.interrupted canonical publication restores exact baseline before recording terminal recovery
atomicRevision.rollbackRecoveryResult: interrupted promotion leaves the canonical baseline byte-identical and does not create a fully accepted head
atomicRevision.provisionalLineageTest: decompengine.repair.RepairRunSemanticsTest.restart retains a verified provisional snapshot as nonaccepted interrupted evidence
atomicRevision.provisionalLineageResult: provisional candidate bytes remain addressable as evidence while canonical source and fully accepted head remain unchanged

focusedValidation.command: ./gradlew --no-daemon test --tests 'decompengine.repair.ModuleRevisionGraphTest.sparse index selects bounded context for more than five thousand functions' --tests 'decompengine.repair.ModuleRevisionGraphTest.durable graph publication crash points recover an exact pending attempt' --tests 'decompengine.repair.RepairRunSemanticsTest.interrupted canonical publication restores exact baseline before recording terminal recovery' --tests 'decompengine.repair.RepairRunSemanticsTest.restart retains a verified provisional snapshot as nonaccepted interrupted evidence'
